claims.statement: Allow multiple image attachments on a node; show only the first thumbnail and open pan/zoom inspection on click.
Pasting an image with no selection creates an image node that supports ordinary graph operations.
Provide left-side title icons from a broad library with an easy picker; library choice remains open.
Support all rich content in the DSL, pasted assets in an assets folder, and diagram-relative or absolute machine paths.
The Product Grid screenshot illustrates thumbnails alongside node text; its full layout is not prescribed.
Existing image insertion downsizes to 2048 pixels and stores data URLs; the DSL rejects images and icons.
Pasting an image with exactly one ordinary node selected attaches it to that node.
Preserve original image detail and use smaller thumbnails on the graph.
Keep external image references by default; provide a Make portable action that copies images into assets and updates DSL links.
claims.notes: Copying into diagram assets interprets make portable; exact folder arrangement and action placement remain design details.

claims.statement: First-version attachment management includes removal and choosing the first displayed image.
The icon picker supports name and related-term search plus a browsable grid.

shape.appetite: Extend the existing local .draft editor; no separate asset manager or parallel browser asset store. No time estimate is assumed.
shape.problem: Visual node content cannot round-trip through the DSL; existing image insertion discards original detail.
shape.recommended_shape: DSL-owned ordered attachments, image nodes, and stable icon names; filesystem originals, disposable previews, one inspection viewer, a compact icon picker, and explicit portable conversion.

success_moves.move: Keep source dimensions independent of decoded image dimensions.
success_moves.risk_reduced: Image arrival or failure must not change canonical geometry or separate CLI and browser layouts.
success_moves.proof: Compare geometry before/after load and with a missing image using the same source.

success_moves.move: First prove original file upload, DSL save, and reopen against a real temporary folder.
success_moves.risk_reduced: A working preview can otherwise hide downscaled or unsaved image data.
success_moves.proof: Compare original bytes and reload saved attachments and image-node references.

success_moves.move: Make portable copies originals before changing source and uses the existing revision check.
success_moves.risk_reduced: A failed copy or external source edit must not leave broken rewritten links.
success_moves.proof: Move the completed folder; inject one missing image and one source conflict; confirm original source is retained.

success_moves.move: Reuse graph operations and SVG scene rendering; isolate asset resolution from layout.
success_moves.risk_reduced: A new image subsystem could bypass grouping, undo, copied content, and drawing exports.
success_moves.proof: Connect and group an image node, undo insertion, and open browser/CLI exports without the local server.

success_moves.move: Use one local icon catalog and search index; defer extra picker features.
success_moves.risk_reduced: Multiple libraries or remote search add complexity before icon discovery is proven.
success_moves.proof: Keyboard-select an icon through related-term search and verify its name survives a DSL reload.

first_proof.question: Can file-backed rich images preserve original detail and stable geometry through save/reopen and portable conversion?
first_proof.artifact: Temporary real .draft file, two attachment images including a >2048px original, one image node, and one external image reference; move the portable folder.
first_proof.decision_rule: Proceed to picker/viewer polish only if original bytes, attachment order, fixed geometry, and moved-folder resolution survive; otherwise fix persistence or geometry first.

rabbit_holes: Automatic asset cleanup conflicts with undo and shared references; keep files when unlinking.
Thumbnail decoding must never participate in compiler geometry.
Absolute paths need a local serving seam restricted to images actually referenced by an opened diagram; do not add a generic arbitrary-file endpoint.
Existing NodeView suppresses glyphs on some shapes, nodeLabel reserves icon space on only some shapes, and CLI SVG is a separate renderer; each needs explicit content-fit verification.
External image URLs cannot simply be copied into SVG exports used for PNG rasterization; materialize visible image bytes before serialization.
Scratch/static usage lacks filesystem writes; save a local diagram first rather than add another persistence model.
provisional_defaults: Other paste selections create an image node; text editing retains its native paste behavior.
Image nodes open through an explicit action or double-click; thumbnail click opens attachments.
Preview below title, dimensions reserved; verify fit for box, pill, circle, diamond, and text shapes.
assets/ sits beside each diagram; collision-safe filenames, no mutation of source image files.
Lucide is proposed, not a user-selected dependency; choose a package only after confirming local SVG catalog and search metadata.
Portable conversion covers the current diagram; no workspace-wide packaging.
Without a writable diagram, offer Save as file before paste/import.

counterproposal.proposal: Keep data URLs and the existing small icon selector, adding only DSL attributes.
counterproposal.decision: Rejected: data URLs do not meet requested filesystem ownership, current downscaling loses detail, and the small selector does not meet icon discovery intent.
counterproposal.simplification_retained: Reuse graph behavior and file-session edits; originals in files, generated previews only in memory/cache; no independent asset database.

shape.source_of_truth: .draft owns image references, image order, stable icon names, and geometry. Filesystem owns original bytes. Browser image URLs, previews, zoom, and viewer selection are derived session state.
shape.transition: First usable intermediate supports DSL-authored image content with save/reopen. Then add clipboard attachment writes, portable conversion, inspection and picker. No automatic legacy data migration or dual-version support.
shape.rollback: Keep changes isolated in coherent commits and temporary proof fixtures. Portable conversion never deletes source images; undo restores prior references, leaving copied files available. Failed copies do not change source links. No runtime feature-flag framework.
plan_refinements: Normalizing projected documents currently accepts only data URLs; round-trip support includes that real boundary.
Add source-base context when copying references between diagrams; no cross-workspace asset copying.
Until rich exports are complete, explicitly refuse affected exports rather than emit missing content.

question_rounds.focus: Paste targeting, fidelity, portability, attachment handling, icon discovery

questions.question: Should pasting with one ordinary node selected attach the image?
questions.answer: Attach to the selected node; no selection creates an image node.
questions.effect: Confirmed append-to-selected-ordinary-node behavior; empty selection creates image node.

questions.question: Should saved images preserve original detail?
questions.answer: Keep the original; use a smaller thumbnail on the graph.
questions.effect: Preserve originals as files; generated thumbnails are derived.

questions.question: Should external path references remain linked, be copied, or offer a choice?
questions.answer: Keep the reference; include an option to make portable and update links.
questions.effect: Added explicit Make portable copy-and-rewrite flow; linking remains default.

questions.question: Which attachment management actions belong in the first version?
questions.answer: Remove images and choose which appears first.
questions.effect: Included removal and first-image choice; deferred general reorder/replacement.

questions.question: Which icon discovery workflow matters most?
questions.answer: Search by name or related terms, plus a browsable grid.
